The brazen clash of cymbals now assaults the ear, and 狄俄尼索斯, emerging from his sacred Mysteries, comes in view with his cleft-footed satyrs, whirling about their cleft-footed females, among them 西勒诺斯 riding his long-eared beast braying to split the heavens. Nothing is spared! Nothing! Cleft hooves trample decency into the dust, senses whirl, ears are deafened, drunkards grope their way to wine bowls, heads are splitting, bellies bursting, and anyone who calls for caution only swells the raging tumult, for to house the brave new wine wineskins must be emptied fast. (The curtain falls, 福耳库阿斯, in the proscenium, rises up a gigantic figure, then steps down from her cothurni, pushes back her mask and veil, and reveals herself to be 梅菲斯特—in order, as far as necessary, to comment on the piece in an epilogue.)
translation:
@@U03954@@
铙钹的猛烈撞击声现在袭击了耳朵，狄俄尼索斯从他的神圣神秘中显现出来，与他的裂足萨特们一起出现在视野中，围绕着他们的裂脚女性旋转，其中西勒诺斯骑着他的长耳野兽，嘶鸣着撕裂天空。什么都不能幸免！没有什么！蹄子裂开，把体面践踏在尘土里，感官旋转，耳朵震聋，醉汉摸索着拿到酒碗，头颅劈裂，肚子爆裂，任何人的警告只会加剧汹涌的骚动，因为容纳勇敢的新酒的酒袋必须很快倒空。 （幕落落下，福耳库阿斯在舞台上升起一个巨大的人物，然后从她的衣帽间走下来，推开她的面具和面纱，露出自己是梅菲斯特——以便在必要时在尾声中评论这部作品。）
